about: Lara Roeske Fernandez is an attorney providing legal services covering Creditor Debtor Rights: Business and Bankruptcy: Business.

Lara Fernandez, who practices law in Tampa, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Emory University School of Law. She graduated in 1996. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1996.
